 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The final injury report for the showdown between the Florida State Seminoles and Boston College Eagles has been released. There are multiple changes for FSU.
 Running back Quintrevion Wisner and defensive lineman Cam Brooks are off the injury report after being listed as probable. Also, defensive back K.J. Kirkland is now a game-time decision.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Wide receiver Duce Robinson, running backs Ousmane Kromah and Sam Singleton Jr., defensive backs Quindarrius Jones, Karson Hobbs, and Jamari Howard, linebackers Blake Nichelson, Izayia Williams, Daylen Green, and Noah LaVallee, defensive linemen Deante McCray and Kevin Wynn, and kicker Conor McAneney are out.
 Nothing has changed for Boston College. Defensive lineman Onye Nwosisi, defensive back Isaiah Farris, linebacker Justin Medlock, running backs Evan Dickens and Sedric Addison, offensive linemen Trevon Humphrey, Michael Crounse, and Amir Johnson, and wide receiver Reed Swanson are all out.
 Florida State and Boston are kicking off on the ACC Network at noon ET. The Seminoles are a 6-point favorite.
